final_proof:
Let \(I=(-\pi,\pi]\) be the stated half-open interval of conventional direction angles. For a nonzero vector \(\mathbf a=(x,y)\), put \(r=\sqrt{x^2+y^2}>0\). Its direction is the unique \(\theta\in I\) such that
\[
\cos\theta=\frac{x}{r},\qquad \sin\theta=\frac{y}{r}.
\]
Uniqueness within \(I\) follows because two angles having the same sine and cosine differ by an integral multiple of \(2\pi\). The difference of two members of \(I\) lies strictly between \(-2\pi\) and \(2\pi\), so that multiple can only be zero. We now identify this unique angle in every case.

Recall that the principal real arctangent takes its values in \((-\pi/2,\pi/2)\). Thus, if \(\phi=\arctan(y/x)\), then \(\tan\phi=y/x\) and \(\cos\phi>0\).

Suppose first that \(x>0\). Then
\[
\cos\phi=\frac{1}{\sqrt{1+\tan^2\phi}}
=\frac{1}{\sqrt{1+(y/x)^2}}=\frac{x}{r},
\qquad
\sin\phi=\tan\phi\cos\phi=\frac{y}{r}.
\]
Moreover, \(\phi\in(-\pi/2,\pi/2)\subset I\). By uniqueness,
\[
\theta=\phi=\arctan(y/x).
\]

Now suppose that \(x<0\). The same calculation, with \(|x|=-x\), gives
\[
\cos\phi=\frac{-x}{r},\qquad
\sin\phi=\frac{y}{x}\frac{-x}{r}=-\frac{y}{r}.
\]
Consequently, for either choice of sign,
\[
\cos(\phi\pm\pi)=-\cos\phi=\frac{x}{r},
\qquad
\sin(\phi\pm\pi)=-\sin\phi=\frac{y}{r}.
\]
If \(y\geq0\), then \(y/x\leq0\), so \(\phi\in(-\pi/2,0]\). Hence \(\phi+\pi\in(\pi/2,\pi]\subset I\), including the endpoint \(\phi+\pi=\pi\) when \(y=0\). Uniqueness therefore gives
\[
\theta=\arctan(y/x)+\pi.
\]
If instead \(y<0\), then \(y/x>0\), so \(\phi\in(0,\pi/2)\). Hence \(\phi-\pi\in(-\pi,-\pi/2)\subset I\), and uniqueness gives
\[
\theta=\arctan(y/x)-\pi.
\]

It remains to consider \(x=0\). If \(y>0\), then \(r=y\), so
\[
(x/r,y/r)=(0,1)=(\cos(\pi/2),\sin(\pi/2)),
\]
and therefore \(\theta=\pi/2\). If \(y<0\), then \(r=-y\), so
\[
(x/r,y/r)=(0,-1)=(\cos(-\pi/2),\sin(-\pi/2)),
\]
and therefore \(\theta=-\pi/2\).

Finally, if \(x=y=0\), then \(r=0\), so the normalization \(\mathbf a/r\), and hence a direction angle, does not exist. Thus the direction is undefined. These cases give exactly the asserted formula.
